correctness.rationale: The proof decomposes σ_{-3} into factors at 2,3,5,7 and the primes ≥11. The five exceptional tail-prime rational inequalities and Nagura's >25 prime-gap theorem bound the tail by each successive Euler factor; Sanna Lemma 2.3 then gives a full interval [1,T], not merely a sampled set. Exponent cutoffs (2,2),(3,1),(5,1),(7,1) reduce the complete infinite small-prime exponent choices to 24 exact interval states. An independently written Fraction-based calculation verified all four cutoff inequalities, 5 tail-start comparisons, the strict ζ(3) enclosure (100 terms), all 24 states, every one of 14 asserted rational endpoint pairs and density masses, 13 strict gaps, and mass one. CRT valuation frequencies give natural densities; the finite certificate is not used for the infinite tail. The closure includes all endpoints as accumulation points; the 14 components are genuinely disjoint.
